description: The playhead losses of a reel-to-reel machine on their own: the treble a tape head loses to its gap, to the tape's thickness and to the space between them, plus the head bump

params.text: Sets the width of the playhead gap, 1 to 50 microns; a wider gap loses more treble
Sets the thickness of the tape, 0.1 to 50 microns; thicker tape loses more treble
Sets the space between the playhead and the tape, 0.1 to 20 microns; more space loses more treble
Sets the tape speed the losses are worked out for, 1 to 50 inches per second; a faster tape keeps more treble and moves the head bump up

notes: it only takes away, it adds no distortion of its own: the module is a 64-tap filter built from the three loss equations, followed by one peaking filter for the head bump.
the four knobs all come up at the middle of their travel, which is a 10 micron gap, 15 micron tape, about 10 microns of spacing and 15 inches per second, so a new module is already filtering.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only
